node.title: Re: why is $1 cleared at end of an inline sub?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
As documented in [doc://perlvar#Variables-related-to-regular-expressions] and lower down for $1:

These variables are read-only and dynamically-scoped.

The dynamic scoping (see also [doc://perlsub#Temporary-Values-via-local()]) makes sense because it means code like this still works:

sub do_something_else { my $foo = "quzbaz"; $foo =~ /([aeiou]+)/ and print ">$1\n"; # prints ">u" } my $bar = "foobar"; if ( $bar =~ /([aeiou]+)/ ) { do_something_else(); print "$1\n"; # still prints "oo", not "u" }

As a general rule, regular expression variables that you want to keep for later use should be copied into other variables ASAP, and only if the match was successful.

Update: Better link instead of [doc://local]
